dog.description_text: My foster writes: A super gentle and curious little girl that has so much personality and makes the perfect companion. Wednesday had no trouble warming up to her foster home and immediately wanted to always be near a person. She will accompany you in whatever you are doing whether it's sitting next to you on the couch or watching you cook dinner. She's a big cuddle bug and after a few pets will come curl up on your lap. Wednesday loves to play, her favorite toys are wand toys, and she also loves a scratching post/ cat tree. She is a chatty girl and will greet you with little meows. The quickest way to her heart is wet food and churu cat treats. She doesn't mind having company and will come say hi, but favors the person she feels most comfortable with. She definitely loves a lot of attention and would be a perfect buddy for somebody who can reciprocate all the time and love she has to give!
dog.name: Wednesday
